answer: Stake the identity: each agent locks real collateral when it registers, and peer attestations slash that stake if its work is judged fraudulent. A sybil attacker must fund every fake with capital, and each dishonest twin burns its deposit, so flooding the pool becomes economically suicidal. Honest nodes verify cheaply: signed receipt chains flow through a narrow canyon that a swarm cannot forge in time, while unbacked fakes decay like yarrow in dry wind. Per-identity stakes keep fake identities ivory-priced.
